purpose: Measure the frozen baseline's search and evidence failure distribution on a larger fresh development slice before designing another intervention.
problem: The rejected constraint_portfolio_v1 probe lost 29.45 percentage points of evidence recall while issuing 38.36 percent fewer searches. Five questions are enough to stop that candidate but too few to choose a robust repair trigger.
simpler_method: Profile the unchanged baseline once on fresh questions; do not introduce another prompt or agent layer yet.
decision_use: Select one measurable repair trigger and preregister it on another fresh development slice. Do not tune against these 25 answers and evaluate on the same slice.
claim_boundary: This is development-set error profiling for a frozen-model harness. It is not official benchmark accuracy, leaderboard evidence, or a model-capability improvement.
